Careers

Shapea neweraofmarketing

Join our ambitious team.

See vacanciesSee vacancies

What we’re building

Advertising doesn’t have to be this hard.

Pixis was built by people who’ve been in the weeds of ad campaign chaos. Our mission is simple: give advertisers tools that remove the noise and deliver real results. We’re here to make building high-performing ads easier, faster, and more effective.

And we’re just getting started.

Make an impact. Grow your career.

We’re looking for curious, creative, collaborative people to grow with us. If you’re excited by meaningful work that has a real impact, you’ll fit right in.

Whether you’re designing better user experiences, shipping new features, or supporting our customers, you’ll have the opportunity to shape a product people genuinely need and love. And while you’re doing that, we’ll support your growth every step of the way.

A team you’ll love to work with

Incredible things happen when people feel supported, included, and excited to show up every day. Here’s what drives our culture:

Empowerment

We hire amazing people and trust them to do great work. You’ll have ownership, autonomy, and support from day one.

Team values

No egos. No silos. Just a group of people who collaborate, communicate, and genuinely care about what we’re building together.

Diversity

Different perspectives make for better ideas. We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard, respected, and valued.

Join usJoin us

Life at Pixis

Generous paid time off

so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work.

Flexible work hours and location

to support balance, focus, and the freedom to do your best work.

Competitive compensation and benefits

that reflect your skills, experience, and the value you bring.

Equity opportunities in select roles

so you can share in the success you help build.

A diverse, global team

made up of talented, respectful professionals who bring fresh thinking from around the world.

A culture that rewards creativity and problem-solving

not just output.

Full trust from our leadership from day one,

with autonomy to own your work and make an impact.

Open roles

There are no vacancies at this time, but we are always on the lookout for passionate people to join our team.
Tell us what you are looking for at [email protected]  — and don’t forget to attach your résumé!
